prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1101; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision that occurred at an intersection. Initial evaluation documented right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion with forward elevation and abduction limited by pain, and tenderness over the anterior joint line. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and no acute bony injury was identified. Clinical findings were consistent with a rotator cuff strain with associated capsular irritation.

Conservative management was initiated and consisted of a structured physical therapy program focusing on pain modulation, progressive range-of-motion exercises, and graduated strengthening of the rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers. Over the course of 19 visits, the patient demonstrated steady improvement in pain levels, active range of motion, and functional tolerance for overhead and lifting activities. Anti-inflammatory medication was used as needed for symptom control.

At the most recent visit, the patient reported substantial but incomplete resolution of symptoms, with residual mild discomfort during end-range overhead activity. Strength testing showed near-symmetric function compared with the unaffected side. Continued home exercise is recommended, with reassessment if symptoms recur or fail to continue improving.
